article_manifest.title: Niger: Nearly 64,000 Flee Nigeria for Niger Where a Humanitarian Crisis Is Deepening
article_manifest.original_title: Niger: Nearly 64,000 Flee Nigeria for Niger Where a Humanitarian Crisis Is Deepening
article_manifest.summary: Violence in northern Nigeria is fueling a growing humanitarian crisis across the whole region: 64,000 have fled to neighbouring Niger and several hundred have left for Benin since the start of the year, as host countries struggle to cope, the UN's refugee agency (UNHCR) said on Tuesday. Northern Nigeria has been experiencing multiple, overlapping security crises involving jihadist insurgencies, armed banditry, and farmer-herder conflicts, forcing millions from their homes over the past 25 years.

article_manifest.title: FRN ARMED OFFENSIVE: Kabila goes from threat to act
article_manifest.original_title: OFFENSIVE ARMEE DU FRN : Kabila passe de la menace à l’acte
article_manifest.summary: Only a few days after the launch of his political-military movement called Front pour la refondation de la nation (FRN), the former Congolese president, Joseph Kabila, went from threat to act After an armed offensive launched at the end of last week, he managed to conquer several localities where the Congolese army and its allies had a forward command centre and a supply point.

article_manifest.title: Niger-Algeria: EU clarifies its position after protests in Niamey and Algiers
article_manifest.original_title: Niger-Algérie : l’UE clarifie sa position après les protestations de Niamey et d’Alger
article_manifest.summary: The European Union (EU) assured on Tuesday that it had never asked Niger or Algeria for explanations on their military cooperation, returning to the controversy aroused by the statements of its spokesperson concerning the deployment of Algerian troops in Nigerian territory “The Algerian decision to deploy troops in Niger is part of the bilateral relationship between Algeria and Niger,” Anouar El Anouni, EU foreign affairs spokesman, told the European Commission's press briefing in Brussels.

article_manifest.title: Douentza and Koro: the return of displaced people facing significant challenges
article_manifest.original_title: Douentza et Koro : le retour des déplacés confronté à d’importants défis
article_manifest.summary: After several years of displacement, the inhabitants of Drimbé, in the Douentza circle, are starting preparations for their return. They are mobilizing to clear their village, abandoned for nearly eight years. In the Koro circle, several localities have already welcomed some of their inhabitants.

article_manifest.title: Africa Corps Leads Deadly Drone Campaign in Mali
article_manifest.original_title: Africa Corps Leads Deadly Drone Campaign in Mali
article_manifest.summary: Images out of northern Mali show attacks by or wreckage from Russian-operated drones targeting Tuareg separatists, terrorists and civilians alike. Experts say the images are evidence that Russia’s Africa Corps mercenaries have taken control of the ruling junta’s air campaign and may be committing war crimes. According to the Armed Conflict Location and Event Data (ACLED) project, Africa Corps and the Malian junta killed 89 civilians in 49 airstrikes between April and August, more than double the number from the same period the year before.

article_manifest.source: OCHA Afrique de l'Ouest et du Centre
article_manifest.title: Mali: Displaced families in Sarema seek safety and a way forward
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: Displaced families in Sarema seek safety and a way forward
article_manifest.summary: By Seynabou Niang Families displaced by violence in central Mali are starting over in Sarema, located 640 kilometers north-east of the capital Bamako, in the Mopti Region. While some arrived just a few months ago, others have been here since late 2024. A new place to call home In Mali's Bandiagara Region, Soumaila Djiguiba used to earn a living trading livestock in Kori-Kori.

article_manifest.title: Support for SDS orphans: The Pananetugri Initiative provides school kits to orphans
article_manifest.original_title: Soutien aux orphelins des FDS : L’Initiative Pananetugri remet des kits scolaires aux orphelins
article_manifest.summary: The Pananetugri Initiative for the Well-being of Women (IPBF) has handed over 215 school kits to the Directorate of Social Action and Psychological Services of the National Gendarmerie (DASSP-GN) of Burkina Faso for the benefit of the children of fallen soldiers. It was Friday, October 9, 2026 . On the occasion of the start of the 2026-2027 school year, the Pananetugri Initiative for the Well-being of Women (IPBF) is making its heart speak for the children of fallen soldiers.

article_manifest.title: MOSOP accuses Niger Delta governors of mismanaging 13% derivation funds
article_manifest.original_title: MOSOP accuses Niger Delta governors of mismanaging 13% derivation funds
article_manifest.summary: ….Group calls for amendment of derivation law, commends NDDC’s development efforts By Daniel Abia PORT HARCOURT — The Movement for the Survival of the Ogoni People (MOSOP) has accused successive governors in the Niger Delta of mismanaging the 13 per cent derivation funds, calling for an amendment of the law to ensure that oil-producing communities directly benefit from the revenue.

article_manifest.title: Niger-EU: Niamey raises its voice after statements on the Algerian military deployment
article_manifest.original_title: Niger-UE : Niamey hausse le ton après les déclarations sur le déploiement militaire algérien
article_manifest.summary: The reception of the European Chargé d 'affaires by the Nigerien Prime Minister on 9 November illustrates the tensions aroused by Brussels' requests for explanations on the deployment of Algerian soldiers in Niger, an initiative that Niamey considers to be fully within its sovereignty . The Prime Minister of Niger, Ali Mahamane Lamine Zeine, received Monday, November 9, 2026 the Chargé d 'affaires of the European Union (EU) in Niamey, following statements by the spokesperson of the European Commission on the deployment of Algerian military units in Niger .

article_manifest.title: Shangarha explains the nature of the mission of the Algerian army in Niger… and the President of the African Parliament responds to the statements of the spokesman of the European Union
article_manifest.original_title: شنقريحة يشرح طبيعة مهمة الجيش الجزائري في النيجر… ورئيس البرلمان الإفريقي يرد على تصريحات الناطق باسم الاتحاد الأوروبي
article_manifest.summary: Algeria - “Al-Quds Al-Arabi”: The speech of the Chief of Staff of the Algerian Army, General Said Shangarha, shed more light on the nature of the military mission in Niger, at a time when responses are continuing to the statements of the spokesman of the European Union, which called on Algeria to provide clarifications after the adoption of the resolution Shangarha said that sending a military formation to northern Niger falls within the framework of protecting joint energy installations and projects between the two countries, in response to the request of the Nigerian authorities, and within the approach of…

article_manifest.title: Mali: Fama bomb terrorist groups in Menaka and Kidal
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : Les FAMA bombardent des regroupements terroristes à Ménaka et Kidal
article_manifest.summary: In a statement issued yesterday Sunday, November 8, the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Mali informs that the country's Armed Forces, supported by their partners, bombed several terrorist groups on Friday, November 06 and Saturday, November 07, 2026 in Menaka and Kidal "On Friday, November 6, 2026, the exploitation of precise intelligence, made it possible to locate about 50 kilometers southwest of the city of Menaka, a terrorist group with war materials.

article_manifest.title: A European request that angered Algeria about the deployment of its army in Niger
article_manifest.original_title: طلب أوروبي يثير غضب الجزائر بشأن انتشار جيشها في النيجر
article_manifest.summary: The EU's request for clarifications on sending Algerian military units to Niger has sparked controversy and drawn widespread criticism in Algerian media and political circles. The European Union Spokesman for Foreign Affairs, Policy and Security Affairs expressed the Union's concern and follow-up to the Algerian military move and the deployment of army units in Nigerian territory The European Union is awaiting clarifications from Algeria on the deployment of units of the Algerian army in Niger, the extent, objective and basis of this deployment, the European official said in press statements.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso: Armed Group Kills Civilians
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso: Armed Group Kills Civilians
article_manifest.summary: An Al-Qaeda-linked armed group killed at least 27 civilians in two attacks in Burkina Faso’s northern Yatenga province in September 2026. The group’s relentless, unlawful attacks put civilians across Burkina Faso at grave risk. The laws of war prohibit attacking civilians, and those who order, commit, or assist serious violations of the laws of war with criminal intent may be prosecuted for war crimes.

article_manifest.title: Niger: Floods - Sep 2026
article_manifest.summary: Disaster description As of 1 September, floods have affected 34,372 people (5,470 households), causing 44 deaths and 95 injuries. Maradi, Zinder and Dosso are the worst affected, with 4,412 houses collapsed, 43 classrooms damaged, livestock losses and destroyed food stocks. Priorities include household assistance, emergency shelter, protection of displaced people and restoration of essential services.
